title: Medicaid - federal/state framework
facts: Medicaid is a joint federal-state health coverage program administered by states under federal requirements.
Federal law requires states to cover certain mandatory eligibility groups and permits states to cover additional optional groups.
The ACA created an option for states to expand Medicaid coverage to a broader group of low-income adults, so adult eligibility differs materially by state.
A specific Medicaid eligibility answer requires current state rules as well as federal eligibility rules.
